scope: Synthetic accounts/content for host-boundary checks; actual ContactService, encrypted SQLite, HTTP owner approval, sandboxed Chrome and native Windows Node. Selected-subscription model trials are reported separately below; no physical phone acceptance.

native_windows.scope: Earlier full browser/UI boundary run; unchanged Chrome and UI paths. Later runtime amendments are checked separately below.

browser: exact owner preview: zero autosaves before approval, one after approval, zero extra model calls
changed target: zero autosaves, confirmed non-application
text and file preflight detect changed targets before staging, then allow fresh observation without any input/change/submit events
ui: actual desktop 1280px and narrow 390px rendered without horizontal overflow
plain text including script-looking content; invisible formatting characters shown
authenticated HTTP rejects unreviewed extra value
saved action result remains on the request after ephemeral preview disappears
regressions: Receipt context uses actual serialized byte budget; fifteen effects cannot prevent further conversation. Full journal receipts remain available.
Invalidated in-flight preview clears after reconciliation; queued newer owner work cannot retain an older preview.
Applied mismatch is distinct from uncertain dispatch; historical file verification describes download bytes only.
Default mode receives recent approved effect receipts without enabling historical search.
History returns complete receipt pages within model budget, using an optional backward-compatible receipt_offset; stable ordering and no loss across pages.
All enabled local tools plus recent mail list/body reads remain within the existing 14000-byte local context.

Mandatory effect notes remain visible with Google, mail and related-mail tools in the default 14000-byte context. The latest complete receipts fit 512 serialized bytes; omitted full records remain paged.
Failed or refused preparations leave no valid-preview claim. Followup notices cannot restore redacted transfer bytes to the next checkpoint.
Read-only planner discovery can switch to an isolated editor after releasing its snapshot; the editor still receives no planner private context.
File preflight rechecks current file and submit target after asynchronous original-byte reading; shared validation inserts no await before the actual setter.
Read-only selected-file bodies and opaque provider continuation are absent from future checkpoints and serialized subscription input after unsharing/restart; visible answers remain.
Approval headers and JSON body have a bounded 30-second wait. Unknown application is not replayed; fresh server state unlocks a newer preview and late old replies cannot replace it.

Large connected toolsets select schemas on demand with budget rollback; source authority and existing subscription direct calls are unchanged. Synthetic-model validation, not real local-model quality proof.
Read-only mail reconciliation preserves pending/same-turn browser preparation; owner send admission, editing and discard still invalidate it.
Shared-page-only observations also clear subsequent opaque continuation; same-host and restart paths preserve visible answers without replaying expired raw input.
Warm receipt history updates only the changed action, without decrypting prior file payloads. Transaction rollback invalidates the derived cache; reopening reproduces persisted receipts.

History pagination fits the final response after public research sources and notes are restored. All 17 complete effect receipts survive bounded pages; failed admission grants no historical-source recall or owner-context read.

receipt_cache_benchmark.scope: Single local synthetic measurement; 1000 records with 32768-byte originals and replacements. Not end-to-end UI or latency percentile qualification.

durability: Existing v5 browser action formats only; derived per-turn receipts and history retrieval, no original answer rewrite or new database migration. Pending preview not restored and private proposal arguments removed from future checkpoint.
limits: DOM verification is not server persistence; fixture autosave is independent test evidence only.
Files preserve original and replacement bytes; dispatch is not upload/application qualification.
Five-minute preview only on requesting device; changed authority, owner work, page preconditions or restart prevent reuse.
Only fixed A08/A02/A03 synthetic environments are requalified here; no whole-product or market-release acceptance.

actual_model.prior_runs: Failed first runs retained; situated second run hit evaluation-only 32-request cap and is not a full pass. Third run uses the harness default 48 cap with unchanged product/fixtures/criteria.
